name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after a career in corporate communications. A chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She transitioned into motorsport, leveraging her existing skills to build relationships with media outlets and craft compelling narratives around drivers and teams.

At Racing Start Academy, Astrid is responsible for shaping the public image of the drivers and the team. She believes in transparent communication and fostering genuine connections. Her methodical approach ensures every press release, interview, and social media post aligns with the team's strategic goals. She's known for her ability to turn even the most challenging situations into opportunities for positive exposure.

What sets Astrid apart is her dedication to nurturing young talent. She goes beyond simply promoting drivers; she mentors them on how to present themselves professionally and navigate the pressures of the spotlight. She views herself as a protective shield for the drivers, ensuring their voices are heard while safeguarding their reputations.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy blonde hair, often pulled back into a practical low ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid has a warm, approachable face with a few laugh lines around her kind blue eyes.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong black coffee on her desk.
Keeps a meticulously organized spreadsheet of press contacts.
Carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during meetings, even if she's just listening.
